lines.hook: What if you dug a hole straight through the Earth, and jumped in?
lines.start: Start in Spain, and the other end comes out in New Zealand.
lines.air: Pump out all the air first. Then, jump.
lines.km1: Fourteen seconds later, you're one kilometer down, doing five hundred kilometers an hour.
lines.kola: At twelve kilometers, you pass the deepest hole humans have ever dug.
lines.crust: A minute and a half in, you've fallen right through the crust.
lines.mantle: Then the mantle: three thousand kilometers of rock so hot, it flows.
lines.core: Thirteen minutes in, you drop into an ocean of liquid iron.
lines.inner: The inner core is as hot as the surface of the Sun. Hope you packed a heat-proof suit.
lines.center: At nineteen minutes, you shoot through the very center at thirty-five thousand kilometers an hour.
lines.weight: Strangest part? You've been weightless the entire time.
lines.slow: Now gravity pulls you back. You slow down, and down.
lines.pop: Thirty-eight minutes after you jumped, you float up out of the ground in New Zealand. Feet first.
lines.still: For a split second, you hang there, perfectly still.
lines.back: Then you fall all the way back.
lines.outro: And you'd keep doing it forever.
